Hi Emma — thanks for the docs and the clear questions. Quick responses below and a proposed mutual action plan so we can hit go on invoices next billing cycle.

1) PO header fields: please include PO#, Invoice#, Supplier Tax ID, and "Redwood Project Code" (we will provide the code on the PO email). Our PO gateway performs 3-way matching on PO#, invoice#, and delivered quantity; the extra Project Code helps routing to the right product team.

2) Standard payment window: our default for new strategic vendors is Net 45 while credit reviews complete. However, we can make an exception for Q4 onboarding and run Net 30 for the initial 90-day period subject to: 
   - Valid PO from Redwood that includes the Project Code
   - Completed vendor form & W-9 (received)

3) Early-pay program: we are testing an early-pay pilot with a small set of suppliers. The pilot terms are typically 1.25% for Net 10 across vendors who enroll and pass Treasury approval. If FlowLane would like to enroll, we'll submit to Treasury for evaluation (turnaround ~5 business days).

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
- Today (Oct 6): Redwood to confirm PO header template and send sample PO. (Action: Marcus)
- Oct 7: FlowLane confirms acceptance of Net 30 for 90 days and returns banking remittance details. (Action: Emma)
- Oct 9: Treasury assesses early-pay enrollment (if FlowLane opts in). (Action: Karthik)
- Oct 12: Legal/Procurement finalize PO and DocuSign. (Action: Marissa)

If that works, I'll attach a sample PO and kick off the PO gateway registration.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — Treasury completed the quick review: FlowLane passes the baseline risk checks. We can approve the early-pay enrollment at 1.25% for Net 10. A couple operational notes:  

- PO schema: see sample PO attached in the HubSpot record (we will push to the PO gateway after signature). Required fields: PO#, Invoice#, Supplier Tax ID, Project Code, Remit Account Reference.
- Remittance and due-date calculation: Invoice due date will be calculated from the vendor's invoice date but will align to FlowLane's cut-off if invoice is submitted within their month-end window; e.g., invoice dated Oct 31 submitted by Nov 3 will be due (Net 30) on Dec 3.
- Next steps: Marissa to issue final PO and Marcuss to send DocuSign link to FlowLane (PO + early-pay enrollment form).
